title: Oozing Malaysian Curry Biryani
description: Sweet and savory dish from Malaysia, made with slow-cooked curry and fluffy basmati rice, great for a monsoon evening. The combination of chives and spices creates a unique flavor profile that's both refreshing and satisfying.

ingredients.name: Chicken breast
ingredients.notes: Boneless and skinless, high protein content

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Grate the ginger for added flavor

ingredients.name: Curry leaves
ingredients.notes: Fresh curry leaves, chopped for garnish

instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and saut7ng until they are translucent and fragrant.
Add the grated ginger and saut7ng for another minute.
Add the red curry paste and saut7ng for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the coconut milk, water, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let it cook for 10-12 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, cook the basmati rice according to package instructions.
Once the rice is cooked, fluff it with a fork and set it aside.
To assemble the biryani, place a scoop of the cooked rice on a plate, followed by a piece of the slow-cooked chicken.
Garnish with chopped chives and curry leaves.
